scope.statement: This protocol records a secondary arithmetic replay of one previously evaluated KNT19-based accounting row. The comparison value and source artifacts predate the packet. The row has no prospective or independent evidential status.

accounting_rule.endpoint_object: alpha_inv at the Thomson endpoint under the recorded self-consistent insertion convention
accounting_rule.comparison_rule: The recorded accounting row is compatible when the recomputed standard on-shell reference deficit lies inside the recomputed interval. It is refuted when all integrity gates pass and the deficit lies outside. An integrity failure is not a scientific refutation.

tabulated_dispersive.description: Published KNT19 scalar compilation replayed through the recorded endpoint accounting
tabulated_dispersive.citation: A. Keshavarzi, D. Nomura, T. Teubner, Phys. Rev. D 101, 014029 (2020), DOI 10.1103/PhysRevD.101.014029, equations (3.15) and (3.16)
tabulated_dispersive.kernel: subtracted on-shell vacuum-polarization dispersion integral at M_Z squared
tabulated_dispersive.covariance_status: published scalar uncertainty components are recorded; raw channel covariance is not ingested
tabulated_dispersive.blind_status: comparison data known before packet construction
tabulated_dispersive.independence_status: secondary arithmetic implementation over the same recorded artifacts; no independent HVP implementation

raw_dispersive.description: Raw electron-positron hadronic cross-section data with kernel, exclusions, and covariance
raw_dispersive.ingest_requirement: frozen channel-level cross-section tables with covariance, release identifiers, units, exclusions, radiative-correction policy, and an explicit kernel specification

independent_code.description: An independent published evaluation code distinct from the pinned compilation chain
independent_code.ingest_requirement: a pinned independent implementation with release, inputs, license, units, kernel convention, exclusions, and covariance policy

lattice_hvp.description: Lattice HVP determination with windowed data and covariance
lattice_hvp.ingest_requirement: frozen lattice windowed data files with covariance, release, units, kernel mapping, and continuum, finite-volume, and scale-setting documentation

fabrication_exclusion: Values recalled from literature memory are not ingests. A class without a byte-pinned repository ingest cannot be marked independently evaluated.
